basic_info.description: Perched on the top floor of a charming boutique building, this inviting two-bedroom, one-bath home blends classic San Francisco character with modern comforts in the heart of Duboce Triangle. The airy living space is enhanced by high ceilings, skylights, and plenty of windows flooding the home with natural light and offering lovely neighborhood views. The kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and generous cabinetry.  Two serene bedrooms offer great light and closet space, and the stylishly updated bathroom comes with a shower over tub. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, a deeded storage unit, and access to a shared roof deck with sweeping city views for quiet relaxation at sunset or intimate gathering with friends. Located in close proximity to Duboce Park, public transit, grocery stores, and the vibrant energy of both the Castro and Lower Haight, 161 Castro #C offers the best of city living in a bright, peaceful retreat.
